tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: List Agent Prompts A to Z packs (free and paid) with one-line summaries, recommend-when guidance, prices and URLs.

tools.name: get_free_pack
tools.description: Return the full raw Markdown (system prompt, template, example, tips, FAQ) of a free pack by slug. Slugs come from list_packs.

tools.name: recommend_pack
tools.description: Given a short description of what the user is trying to do, return up to 3 matching packs (keyword match over summaries and tags) with why-they-match. Prefers free packs first.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: Return the Payhip URL and price for a paid pack or the bundle. The human user completes checkout; do not purchase on their behalf unless they explicitly asked you to.

description: Return the Payhip URL, price, what is inside, proof link, refund line, any active discount code with the discounted price, and the bundle alternative for a paid pack. The human user completes checkout; do not purchase on their behalf unless they explicitly asked you to.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_pack" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Given a short description of what the user is trying to do, return up to 3 matching packs (keyword match over summaries and tags) with why-they-match. Prefers free packs first." → after: "Given a short description of what the user is trying to do, return up to 3 matching packs (keyword match over summaries and tags) with why-they-match. Prefers free packs first; free results include paid_upgrade (the matching paid pack) for when the user wants more."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
